Building: Centre Pompidou, Paris (museum).
The front (−z) is the west face on the sloping piazza.
Footprint: 168.1 m along x by 66 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-84,33],[-83.1,-26.2],[-65.3,-26.6],[-65.4,-28.3],[-68.6,-28.3],[-68.6,-33],[-56.5,-32.9],[-56.5,-28.5],[83.8,-28.6],[84,33]]
Height: the highest point is 42 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the piazza: glazed facade with external escalator tube, structural frame and colored ducts, daylight
  2. side three-quarter from below showing the stepped escalator tube and the exposed steel scaffold-like frame, blue sky
  3. elevated view from a distance showing the whole long rectangular building and its roof with colored vents, Paris rooftops around

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: A long glass-and-steel box about 160 m by 60 m, six floors, wrapped in an exposed structural frame. The frame has vertical posts, floor beams and diagonal braces on the front (-z) face, with colour-coded ducts. The signature features are the zig-zag escalator tube across the front face, the white/blue/red roof vents and ducts, and the exposed frame standing off the glass. The front facade faces -z at about z=-28.
